frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Welcome to Jazzhands! The rhythm game with no buttons, no sticks, just straight-up hand gestures and groove, ya feel me?

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: The game works using computer vision on your device's camera - make sure your spot's clean and clear, and the webcam got a good view of you and your hands.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: If you wanna make this work the best, wear somethin' simple and keep your background plain and well-lit. Ain't nobody tryna see all that extra clutter...

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: The beatdeck will project what gesture it thinks each hand is throwing, try to keep 'em up at head height, about shoulders-width apart and in plain view.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: This newfound technology can be touchy, so stay cool and patient with it. Once you got the flow, you'll be rollin' solo like a boss in no time... let's get this show on the road! Throw up both hands, keep 'em shoulder-width apart, palms open and facing the camera.
